data.summary: This 10‑week plan tackles the weak units first, interleaves new material with practice, and ends with a mixed review and timed practice. Each week is capped at 6 hours and includes concrete tasks and, when available, a live class that aligns with that week’s topics.

weeks.focus: Master the fundamentals of limits and continuity.
tasks: Read and summarize 1.1, 1.2, 1.3; do 10 limit‑value problems from the textbook; write a short reflection on how limits predict instantaneous change.

weeks.focus: Apply the chain rule and implicit differentiation in depth.
tasks: Attend Class 1; review notes; solve 15 chain‑rule problems; solve 10 implicit‑differentiation problems; create a cheat sheet for both techniques.

weeks.focus: Explore inverse functions and their derivatives.
tasks: Do 10 problems on differentiating inverse functions; solve 8 inverse trigonometric derivative problems; compare with power rule results from 2.5.

weeks.focus: Connect derivatives to real‑world motion and related rates.
tasks: Model a velocity–time graph; compute acceleration from a position function; solve 5 related‑rates problems; write a paragraph explaining the physical meaning of the derivative.

weeks.focus: Use the Mean Value Theorem and Extreme Value Theorem.
tasks: Attend Class 2; practice 12 MVT problems; find extrema on 3 different functions; determine increasing/decreasing intervals for each.

weeks.focus: Apply the First Derivative Test to locate local extrema.
tasks: Solve 10 first‑derivative test problems; analyze 5 applied rate‑change problems; review derivative estimation from 2.3.

weeks.focus: Understand accumulation of change and Riemann sums.
tasks: Compute areas using left/right/midpoint Riemann sums for 3 functions; derive the definite integral notation; write a short proof of the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

weeks.focus: Integrate differential equations and sketch slope fields.
tasks: Attend Class 3; solve 8 first‑order differential equations; sketch slope fields for 2 equations; verify solutions analytically.

weeks.focus: Apply integration to real‑world contexts and area between curves.
tasks: Find average values of two functions; compute area between curves for 2 pairs of functions; solve 5 applied integration problems.

weeks.focus: Mixed review and timed practice for exam readiness.
tasks: Take a 60‑minute timed practice test covering all units; review mistakes; create a one‑page cheat sheet summarizing key formulas and theorems.

data.final_week_advice: In the final week, focus on consolidating knowledge through timed practice and targeted review of weak spots. Use the cheat sheet to quickly recall formulas during the exam.
